Package io.jans.fido2.service.readiness

Class NativeReadinessService

java.lang.Object
io.jans.fido2.service.readiness.NativeReadinessService
@ApplicationScoped public class NativeReadinessService extends Object
Runs the native app readiness checks for one configured relying party: feature gate, lookup, RP ID validation, per-RP result cache, rate limits, then the reachability and content checks.

The only input that reaches the network layer is the RP ID stored in the configuration, validated by RpIdValidator. The caller supplies an id to select a configured entry, never a host, URL, port or path, so an id that is not configured is answered with NativeReadinessService.NotFound and no outbound work.

Limits. The configured response size and timeout are clamped to MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES_LIMIT and TIMEOUT_MS_LIMIT; a value that is not positive falls back to its default. A mis-set property therefore cannot remove the cap.

Cache. In memory, per node, one entry per configured RP, so its size is bounded by the configuration. Entries live for nativeReadinessCacheTtlSeconds, but never less than ReadinessRateLimiter.MIN_RECHECK_INTERVAL_MS. In a cluster that means up to one fetch per node per TTL, which ReadinessRateLimiter keeps bounded.

Audit. One log line per executed check with rpId, check, requestedBy, timestamp, result and resolvedIpClass; a cache hit is one line and no fetch. The IP class is a coarse label (never the address). requestedBy is whatever the caller forwarded: the FIDO2 server does not authenticate callers, so the value can be forged by anything that reaches it directly, and is informational until the Config API hop that sets it is trusted.

      public NativeReadinessResult check(String rpConfigId, boolean recheck, String requestedBy)
      Parameters:
      rpConfigId - the RP id exactly as configured in requestedParties
      recheck - skip the cache (still rate limited)
      requestedBy - who asked, as forwarded by the caller; null when not known

      NativeReadinessService.NotFound - when no configured RP has that id
